verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents full CRUD DNS management with broad record-type coverage (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, TLSA, SSHFP, ALIAS, HTTPS, SVCB) plus DNSSEC DS records, bundled with every registered domain — a strong technical DNS story. However, there's no documentation of configurable low TTLs, and community feedback on the actual management UI is mixed (one calls it a fast, minimalist relief, another calls it barebones and not better than competitors), so the 'UI that doesn't fight me' half of the story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit low-TTL support documentation, and stronger independent corroboration that the DNS UI itself (not just API) is friction-free.
